method.build: production web build and immutable arcade release exercised through deployment smoke, CSP portal, and viewport harnesses

designConformance.designClaim: The run presents coral, azure, and gold contracts, supports free-route steering, drops the nearest pending letter on release, opens the gate after all three deliveries, and ends on gate return, zero hull, or timeout.
designConformance.observed: The production runtime creates three differently sealed pending letters and matching islands, steers toward pointer or keyboard targets, resolves release drops against the nearest pending destination, gates return on all three delivered flags, and has success, hull-loss, and 360-second timeout endings.

designConformance.designClaim: Drag steers, release drops, taps of at most 180 ms spend gust before dropping, and keyboard controls provide arrows/WASD, Space, Shift, P, and M.
designConformance.observed: The built runtime distinguishes unmoved presses shorter than 180 ms from drag releases; the short path invokes gust while the other invokes drop. Keyboard handlers implement the promised steering, drop, gust, pause, and mute keys.

designConformance.designClaim: Drops succeed within 42 px, are precise within 20 px, and score 1,000 base plus 400 precision and 250 dry bonuses under a x1.0, x1.5, x2.0 success multiplier that resets on a miss.
designConformance.observed: Runtime delivery uses the 42 px cutoff, 20 px precision threshold, dry bonus, capped three-step multiplier, and resets combo on both missed drops and damage; the creator test asserts representative boundary and score results.

designConformance.designClaim: Final score adds 8 points per remaining second and 250 per remaining hull; grades are S at 5,200, A at 4,200, B at 3,000, otherwise C, with distress D; GameResult.phase is delivered count 0-3.
designConformance.observed: The finish path applies floored remaining seconds and hull bonuses, uses the stated grade boundaries with forced D for distress, and emits the delivered-letter count as phase.

designConformance.designClaim: The ship starts with four hull, hazards remove one hull and grant 1.2 seconds immunity, altitude starts at 76, drains at 2.8/s, restores at 22/s in lift, and at zero costs one hull before restoring to 28 and rearming only above 35; collision wets the first pending letter.
designConformance.observed: The runtime constants and update path match all promised hull, immunity, altitude, recovery, rearm, and first-pending-letter wet-state values; ALT is rendered in the HUD.

designConformance.designClaim: Gust starts at one, caps at three, charges while staying in an updraft, pushes nearby hazards, and briefly protects the hull when spent.
designConformance.observed: The production runtime starts gust at 1, adds a charge after 2.5 seconds accumulated in lift up to 3, pushes hazards within 130 px, and grants 0.7 seconds of ship immunity.

designConformance.designClaim: The gold emergency contract awards 900 points when delivered first or second and 500 points when delivered last.
designConformance.observed: Gold delivery checks the number already delivered and adds 900 below two or 500 when two contracts have already been completed.

designConformance.designClaim: Each completed run accumulates one stamp per 1,000 final-score points and unlocks cosmetic-only hull, sail, and gust-ring appearances at 4, 9, and 15, retaining run-local progress if sandbox storage is unavailable.
designConformance.observed: The finish path floors score/1,000 into stamps, catches storage failure while retaining the in-memory total, and rendering selects the three cosmetic tiers without changing gameplay values.

designConformance.designClaim: The seed varies the horizontal positions of three distinct-color islands, the updraft, and hazards; hazards flow downward and recycle, birds cross horizontally, and lightning cycles through 1.0-second warning, 0.65-second active damage, then cooldown.
designConformance.observed: Seeded logic creates coral, azure, and gold islands plus a seeded lift and hazards. Hazards advance downward and wrap, birds have horizontal velocity, and the four-second lightning phase function uses warning before the 0.65-second active interval and damages only while active.

designConformance.designClaim: A 76 px-wide vertical safe corridor links the route, with every hazard's initial position and movement kept outside it so progression from start to gate is guaranteed.
designConformance.observed: The implementation constrains only each hazard center to be at least 38 px from the corridor center. Collision uses hazard radius plus 17 px ship radius; hazards have radii up to 31 px, so a hazard centered on the corridor boundary can still damage a ship inside the promised corridor. The creator invariant likewise checks center distance only, not collision clearance, so the 76 px hazard-free passage is not guaranteed.

designConformance.designClaim: Visibility loss auto-pauses; WebAudio starts only after first input and supplies reactive wind and event tones; supported environments receive brief haptics; Korean and English expose the same rules and state information.
designConformance.observed: The built runtime pauses on document hiding, creates AudioContext only from pointer or M-key input, synthesizes wind and gust/hit/delivery/gate/sail events, calls optional vibration for game events, and renders equivalent Korean and English instruction and state paths. Locale parity tests pass.

designConformance.designClaim: The game has no banner or interstitial advertising and no IAP.
designConformance.observed: The game and arcade runtime mount the flight canvas directly and do not invoke ad or purchase flows; the verified arcade release contains only its entry module, stylesheet, and three declared font assets.

creatorTests.covers: Delivery radius and scoring, wet-letter ordering, gate condition, final score and grades, seeded route bounds, lightning phases, stamp/cosmetic thresholds, altitude rates, hazard-center corridor invariant, RNG behavior, record persistence, and locale parity.

deployable.observed: npm run build and npm run build:arcade passed; the immutable arcade release verified 5 files (1,618,433 bytes, 92,826-byte JS gzip). Deployment smoke mounted with no console or page errors and sourceHash aff744bcee77793a3841c71748fb1af503bf29ff89e5c64471944dd642762a85. CSP portal checks found no missing assets or violations. Standalone and portal viewport checks passed at 390x844 with uniform fit, sufficient backing resolution, no overflow, and no runtime errors.

notes: Verdict is blocked solely because one concrete GDD safety guarantee is missing; deployability and the creator-selected tests otherwise pass.
No judgment was made about fun, difficulty, originality, balance taste, or whether deterministic/autoplay coverage should have been required.

summary.ko: 제작자 테스트와 프로덕션·아케이드 빌드, 390×844, CSP 및 필수 자산 검증은 통과했다. 그러나 폭 76px 안전 통로는 위험 중심만 경계 밖으로 제한해 충돌 반경이 통로 안으로 들어오므로 GDD의 무위험 진행 보장을 충족하지 못해 출고를 차단한다.
summary.en: Creator tests, production and arcade builds, the 390x844 viewport, CSP, and required assets all passed. Release is blocked because the 76 px safe corridor constrains hazard centers only; collision radii can still enter the corridor, so the GDD's hazard-free progression guarantee is not implemented.
